query: SELECT count(*) AS "count!" FROM tasks task JOIN flow_jobs source ON source.tenant=task.tenant AND source.id=task.run_request->>'sourceJobId' WHERE task.tenant=$1 AND source.flow=(SELECT flow FROM flow_jobs WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2) AND task.created_at>=date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
